classifier: L2-regularised logistic regression (lambda=2, balanced classes, Newton/IRLS) on standardised features
threshold_rule: validation split only: maximise aircraft recall + other-image rejection, ties → closest to 0.5; aircraft recall ≥ 0.98 (airplane rule included)

training_data.positives: VT-PREP-001 aircraft-surface images (VT-DS-001, VT-DS-002; one file per photo group) + ImageNet airliner/warplane/wing samples
training_data.negatives: VT-NEG-001 ImageNet samples (non-aircraft classes; non-commercial research terms) + VT-NEG-002 generated documents/charts/interfaces/plain images (CC0)

uncertain.rule: validation only: maximise aircraft not-rejected rate with non-aircraft admitted ≤ 0.08
